orientation: Check whether inventory is assigned to a named order; do not treat all unshipped units as available.

concepts.name: reserved stock
non_features: Two unassigned units on a shelf are not reserved stock

boundary_cases.case: Two unassigned units on a shelf
boundary_cases.basis: They are not reserved stock, but no evidence classifies them as available stock.

recognition_cues: Is the inventory assigned to a named order?
Do not use unshipped status alone to call stock available.

evidence.claim: Two units assigned to Order 7 are reserved stock.
Two unassigned shelf units are not reserved stock.

unresolved_ambiguities: No definition, approved example, or nonexample is supplied for available stock.
Whether stock can be both, or neither, cannot be established; no either-or question is supported.
